final_audit_INCIDENT.note: The first final_audit call included VEE_SaltPlains (and, more mildly, VEE_GravelBeach) in marineMutators. world_mutators_audit scans the WHOLE PLANET, not just the tiles this session wrote, and VEE_SaltPlains is not actually a coastal-gated def in the live roster note used for BRIEF.md (its gate is inland biome + no-river; the roster text "landlocked (0 coast sides required)" is about NOT touching Ocean, the opposite of a marine check). Including it flagged 313 pre-existing planet-wide VEE_SaltPlains placements (ordinary inland desert salt flats, none of them Twilight Sea tiles, none written this session) as "offenders", and the apply script's auto-remove loop deleted 48 of them plus 2 pre-existing VEE_GravelBeach tiles near a Lake elsewhere on the planet (CoastDirectionAt only recognises Ocean neighbours, not Lake, so a legitimate lake-adjacent gravel beach reads as non-coastal). All 50 were identified from this report's removed_offenders list and RESTORED via a direct jawa/world_mutators_set add + world_commit + world_mutators_get read-back confirming all 50 present again, before any further work continued. The final_audit block below is the CORRECTED re-run: marineMutators restricted to Iceberg,VEE_GravelBeach,VEE_RisingWaters,CoastalAtoll,VEE_LoneIsland,Bay (all genuinely coastal-gated land/ice defs used in this plan), limit raised to 500 so nothing is hidden, and every offender cross-checked against this session's own written tile lists before any removal. offenderCount 13, ALL 13 pre-existing elsewhere on the planet (biomes like AB_PyroclasticConflagration, Volcano, AB_FeraliskInfestedJungle -- nowhere near the Twilight Sea), NONE on a tile this session wrote. Nothing further removed.
